card.title: 96. INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.text: When you deploy another unit, destroy this unit.
card.flavorText: The 96th Infantry Regiment was a unit of the 32nd Infantry Division of the German Wehrmacht. The division was formed in 1936 and first saw combat during the Invasion of Poland in 1939, followed by the Battle of France in 1940. The 32nd Division was then relocated to the Cherbourg peninsula in preparation for Operation Sea Lion, the planned invasion of the United Kingdom which never happened. In 1941 the division was transferred to the Eastern Front where it was encircled by the Soviet Red Army in the Demyansk Pocket along with elements of the 16th Army, just south of Leningrad. The encirclement in the Demyansk Pocket was relieved, but by that time the 32nd had suffered heavy losses. The remainder of the division was withdrawn to the Courland Pocket where it saw heavy combat again during the winter of 1944-45. Finally the remnants of the division surrendered to the Red Army in Poland on May 8th, 1945.
